translation.english_text: Zamindar's palace — Kokila's room.
Night.

source_locator.description: Source block 3: (கோகிலா அறையின் கதவு தட்டப்படுகிறது... படுத்திருந்த கோகிலா விளக்கைத் தூண்டிவிட்டு... எழுந்து சென்று கதவைத் திறக்கிறாள்... விங்கன் உள்ளே வருக

translation.english_text: (The door of Kokila’s room is knocked... Kokila, who had been lying down, turns up the lamp... rises and opens the door... Vingan comes in.)
You?... At this hour...

Don't be startled!... I was there watching when Kalingan stopped you on the way in the palace and spoke to you... That wicked man, who has planned somehow to violate your chastity, is certainly coming here tonight!... I came to teach him a proper lesson and send him away!... Don't be afraid!...

source_locator.description: Source block 4: (என்று சொன்னபடி கதவைச் சாத்திவிட்டு, கதவோரத்து மூலையில் ஒளிந்து கொள்கிறான். கதவு தட்டப்படுகிறது..)

translation.english_text: (As he speaks, he closes the door and hides in a corner beside it. The door is knocked.)

source_locator.description: Source block 5: விங்கன், சைகை மூலமாக கோகிலாவிடம் "போய்க் கதவைத் திற!" என்கிறான்... கோகிலா, ஒருவகை பீதியுடன் சென்று கதவைத் திறக்கிறாள்... தோளில் குழந்தையுடன்

translation.english_text: Vingan signals to Kokila, “Go and open the door!” Kokila, with a kind of fear, goes and opens it... Uma arrives dressed simply like a hut-dweller, the baby on her shoulder.)
Uma! You?...
Yes, me. Where is he?... Your illicit lover?...

source_locator.description: Source block 6: (ஒளிந்திருந்து வெளியே வரும் விங்கனைக் கண்டு) ஓ... இங்கே தான் இருக்கிறீங்களா?...

notes: The source prints no speaker label for this spoken unit; no speaker or immutable dialogue ID is inferred.
translation.english_text: (Seeing Vingan emerge from hiding) Oh... so you are here?...
Uma!... Don't rush, without investigating fully, and speak unjustly about anything!...
(The zamindar, Kalingan and Sadaiyan arrive...)
An outrage may happen... but does a wedded wife have no right to condemn it when she sees it?...
Uma!... He came here because...

No explanation is needed, you faithful one!... Night-time!... A bolted door!... A pleasure-loving pair alone in a private room!... Are you going to offer some other explanation for this shameless business?...
Uma!... Don't speak however your mind takes you!... Listen to what I say!..
There's no need to listen!... After betraying your wife... after being caught red-handed... I don't need to hear any story you're going to tell!...
Come home! I'll explain the details.
That will never happen again!... I don't want to live with a betrayer!.. I absolutely don't!
(taking Uma's hand) Are you coming or not?...
Let go of my hand!..
(with a growl) Mr Vingan!.. Son-in-law!..
All this time you've been throwing chilli powder in our eyes and carrying on an illicit affair with Kokila!

source_locator.description: Source block 8: (விங்கன், உமாவை விட்டு — ஜமீன்தாரிடம் திரும்பி)

translation.english_text: (Vingan releases Uma and turns toward the zamindar.)
What conspiracy is all this?
Did you hear that, Sadaiya!... Apparently I'm the one plotting conspiracies!..
Why, you sinner!.. He is the god who made the young zamindar's daughter herself your wife!... You've done something unworthy even of that god, and now you're talking back as well!...
Appa, opening your eyes is very difficult! But one day I will make them open!..
Leave opening Sadaiyan's eyes aside... All this time you've thrown dust in all our eyes... and carried on an illicit affair with Kokila!...
Ayyo, Amma! (covering her ears and crying out) Uma!.. Believe me!.. (Uma pushes Kokila away.)
Oh!..
(Then Maragatham arrives.)
Zamindar Jambuling Bhoopathi... is displaying every trick he knows!... Must my daughter Kokila become a sacrifice to his... intrigue?
You don't need a mirror to see a wound on your own hand!... Uma herself has seen with her own eyes your daughter and Vingan enjoying themselves!..

Amma!.. You too grew up eating this noble man's food... your son grew up on it too... (pointing to his son) Here... this wastrel fellow grew up on it; why, this whole town grew because of him!.. Can you betray him?...

If ten doctors like you joined together, you'd turn the man who loots a whole town and throws it into the furnace... the thief... the lecher... the robber... the murderer... every one of them into saints.
(furiously) Maragatham!..
I wasn't talking about you!.. I mean, fifteen... sixteen years ago...
(subduing himself) All right... all right... enough! Son-in-law! Mr Vingan!... Until Uma's anger settles, let her stay here... What happened has happened... I'll calm Uma down and send her later!...
Ah!... Good idea!...
Uma, I'm asking you one last time: are you coming with me or not?...
I can't... Here... Kokila! Take her with you!...

I am going to take her with me!... Until you understand that Kokila is my sister, until the eyes of these townspeople and my father's eyes receive light... Kokila and Maragatham Amma will stay with me!.. You... stay here as you wish!... Give me my child!...

source_locator.description: Source block 10: (பிடுங்க முயற்சி — உமா தடுத்தல் — இறுதியில் குழந்தையைப் பறித்துக் கொண்டு)

translation.english_text: (He tries to snatch the baby; Uma resists. In the end he takes the baby from her.)
Maragatham Amma!.. It isn't good for you to remain here any longer. Please, both of you come with me!
(Vingan leaves quickly with the baby.)
(looking at Maragatham as she leaves with Kokila) Maragatham!...
notes: The immutable source record begins with a stage-like phrase before `மரகதம்!...`; English keeps that embedded action within the dialogue-linked unit rather than moving it to a separate stage unit.

translation.english_text: The last chapter in the history of the 'noble man' is being written... I'm going!...
(They leave. The zamindar speaks to Kalingan.)

The last chapter;; we'll soon know whose it is!.. Kalinga!... The plan I made and the drama you staged have succeeded!... We have separated our Uma from that leaky hut quarter!... Now, as we intended, let those huts burn!... Let the crowd of our enemies fall into the blazing fire and be charred! Fire! Fire! Let that fire swallow those I hate!.. Ha!.. Ha!.. Ha!...
